title: Aletheia — Overview
description: The Studio Overview page in Grafana, from Loki and Prometheus, over any time range. Studio-only state (connections, approvals) stays in Studio.

panels.title: Ingest: how much is arriving, how fast, and which sources are driving it
Ingest rate
panels.description: Lines per second over the last minute of the range.

panels.title: Peak rate
panels.description: Highest one-minute rate in the range.

panels.title: Active sources
panels.description: Sources that sent at least one line in the last five minutes of the range.

panels.title: Source activity
panels.description: Lines per second, stacked by source.

panels.title: Severity over time
panels.description: Studio's pre-parse severity guess for each raw line.

panels.title: Threat signals: risk-severity lines and denied traffic
High / critical events
panels.description: Normalized events with OCSF severity_id 4 or above.

panels.title: Engine errors
panels.description: Insert, bus publish and Merkle seal failures in the range.

panels.title: Risk leaderboard
panels.description: Share of each source's lines that are risk severity.

panels.title: Most blocked sources

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (src) (count_over_time({source_id=~"$source"} | json act="action_id", src="src_endpoint.ip" | act="2" | src!="" [$__range])))

panels.description: Source IPs with the most denied events.

panels.title: Most denied ports

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (port) (count_over_time({source_id=~"$source"} | json act="action_id", port="dst_endpoint.port" | act="2" | port!="" | port < 10000 [$__range])))

panels.description: Destination ports with the most denied events.

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (dst) (count_over_time({source_id=~"$source"} | json act="action_id", dst="dst_endpoint.ip" | act="2" | dst!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Normalization & integrity: how much is understood as OCSF, and proof it has not been altered
Events normalized
panels.description: Events parsed fully or partially; the rest are kept raw_only.

panels.title: Stored as template
panels.description: Kept as template + vars and verified to rebuild the raw bytes.

panels.title: Reconstruct mismatches
panels.description: Must stay 0: a stored event that no longer rebuilds its raw line.

panels.title: Traffic: who is talking to whom, on what, and what the firewall did

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (src) (count_over_time({source_id=~"$source"} | json src="src_endpoint.ip" | src!="" [$__range])))
topk(8, sum by (dst) (count_over_time({source_id=~"$source"} | json dst="dst_endpoint.ip" | dst!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top destination ports

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (port) (count_over_time({source_id=~"$source"} | json port="dst_endpoint.port" | port!="" | port < 10000 [$__range])))

panels.description: Ports below 10000; ephemeral client ports are left out.

targets.expr: topk(6, sum by (u) (count_over_time({source_id=~"$source"} | json u="user.name" | u!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Per source
panels.description: Connection and approval state live in Studio; this is what each source actually sent.
